notes.zh-CN: 修复 CodeBuddy 会话里消息被切成碎片的问题。CodeBuddy 会把一轮回答的思考块与正文块按 token 交替下发，此前每切换一次就新起一条消息，一条回答被切成几十个气泡，粗体、行内代码和表格都断在碎片边界上。现在同一类文本流会合并成一条完整消息，只有工具调用、审批和新的用户消息才会结束当前这条。
notes.en: Fixes fragmented messages in CodeBuddy conversations. CodeBuddy interleaves a turn's reasoning and answer chunks token by token; GrokX used to start a new bubble at every switch, cutting one answer into dozens of fragments and breaking bold, inline code and tables at the seams. Each stream is now folded back into one message, and only a tool call, a permission request or a new user message ends it.
